notes.title: A free demo for Ultimate Sheep Raccoon, plus online connection fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We're back with a couple of updates. 

[h2]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon - Free Demo (Aug 15-18)[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/ We're running another FREE DEMO for our upcoming game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2923350/Ultimate_Sheep_Raccoon/]Ultimate Sheep Raccoon[/url][/b]!

Now's your chance to check out the first-ever 8-player chaos, plus meet our jawsome new racer, Gator. We’ve also packed in tons of gameplay updates, so grab your friends and get racing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45341631/3b90fff67ec9e0b02ef098eeb0fc7c6ef3cf34bd.png[/img]
[h3]What's new in the demo?[/h3] 
[list][*][b]8-player support[/b]: For the first time! 
[*][b]New core gameplay[/b]: Start each match in open levels and build the terrain before racing!
[*][b]Updated levels[/b]: Farm, Scrapyard, and Docks are back with refreshed designs, plus a Test Level we'd love your feedback on.
[*][b]6 playable characters 🐊[/b]: Introducing our new competitor, Gator, plus the 5 other animals including Monkey, Chicken, Horse, Sheep, and Raccoon.
[*][b]New blocks[/b]: Try out the frog hookshot 🐸 and fireworks box 🎆
[*][b]Double party box[/b]: When there are 2 players, you get 2 sets of blocks to choose from to help fill up the level.
[*][b]Alternate control schemes[/b]: Swap between two different sets of controls, see which suits you best.
[*][b]Improved clarity[/b]: Better power-up visuals, clearer tutorials, and a new tutorial system. [/list] And as a thank-you for playing the demo, you'll unlock an [b]exclusive in-game reward[/b] when Ultimate Sheep Raccoon officially releases!

A little reminder: This is just a slice of what’s coming – more levels, more characters, and the custom level builder are still on the way. Thanks for racing with us while we keep improving Ultimate Sheep Raccoon together.

[h2]Ultimate Chicken Horse Online Connection Issues[/h2]
We've been receiving several reports about online connection issues. Valve helped us resolve the issue from Thursday, Aug 14, and everyone should be able to play online again.

if you're still experiencing problems, please join the [url=https://discord.gg/UCH]Clever Endeavour Games Discord[/url] and post your issue in the bugs channel. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/51492b579c877826c3d7d58f298c0dfc971bf42f.png[/img]
[h2]Ultimate Merch[/h2]
We've also got some Ultimate Sheep Raccoon merch to grab! It includes a colorful sticker sheet and a comic strip t-shirt of your fave animals.

You can grab them both on [url=https://theyetee.com/collections/ultimate-sheep-raccoon]The Yetee[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/fc8bc79391c023c95fa5cc0a882f58ec62e83338.jpg[/img]
That's all for now, see you soon. 
- Your friends at Clever Endeavour Games

notes.title: Announcing the Pandamonium Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/8528bcc6f7bedd3875741b177c57a079c0e793f6.jpg[/img]
Hello! The [b]FREE Pandamonium Update[/b] is coming to Ultimate Chicken Horse on [b]May 13, 2024[/b] on all supported platforms! Play as the new character, [b]Panda[/b], with your PC and console friends via crossplay!

The [b]Pandamonium Update[/b] adds:
- 1 new character: Panda
- 4 new skins: Brown Bear, Polar Bear, Black Bear, and Blue Bear
- 2 new levels: Islands and Toxic Tower
- 2 new outfits: Mail carrier and Viking
- 3 music tracks: Island Buddies, The Kraken, Toxic Tower
- Improvements and bug fixes

When the update releases, unlock the new content for free by playing levels with a “?” symbol and collecting mystery boxes during the game.

[h2]New Character: Panda[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/df27cd596edfe005c0802f8bdf0fd9d66fb2a891.gif[/img]
Roll out the bamboo carpet - [b]Panda[/b] is here! This fuzzy, monochrome teddy is paw-sitively set on victory! 

Voiced by Tia, our community and marketing manager, Panda is the 13th addition to the Ultimate Chicken Horse roster!

[h2]New Skins: The Four Bears[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/96a02cd8ff5ede37537a0f22c21ad19a4f4de274.jpg[/img]
The four bears are here to play! Please welcome [b]Brown Bear, Polar Bear, Black Bear and Blue Bear.[/b] (They give great hugs.)

[h2]New Levels: Islands and Toxic Tower[/h2]
On the [b]Islands[/b], enjoy a tropical island paradise by day… and summon the legendary Kraken by night! Stir up some chaos for your friends by ringing the Kraken’s bell, and dodge its deadly tentacles under the moonlight! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/9b35c8cc2d556db7fefdbcc414afe2205d6fbf12.jpg[/img]
In [b]Toxic Tower[/b], explore the remains of a polluted factory! Platform across vats of purple sludge, and time your jumps to avoid the bubbling overflow of toxic waste! (Fun fact: The level was inspired by one of the original game jam levels of water tower from 2014!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/401f3b815456c88b758b97da45d15694e3c8c3aa.gif[/img]
[h2]New Outfits[/h2]
Check out Panda and the four Bears’ outfits as they suit up for adventure! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/2527ab7ecc9b4e82813922bd68c21d50779be4cd.jpg[/img][list][*] [b]Viking Hat and Viking Suit: [/b]Ready to take on the world, and look cute doing it.
[*] [b]Mail Hat and Mail Bag:[/b] Special delivery! We come bear-ing gifts.
[/list] [h2]New Merchandise[/h2]
We’re releasing new Ultimate Chicken Horse merchandise to celebrate the Bears’ arrival and 8 years of the game! 

The [b][url=https://theyetee.com/collections/ultimate-chicken-horse]new merch releases on May 13[/url][/b] at the same time as the Pandamonium Update!

[url=https://theyetee.com/collections/ultimate-chicken-horse][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/ec10458d1955c57aae584e7df3502353e2249ed1.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Beary Build Event[/h2]
We’re hosting another custom building event for the Pandamonium Update! Send us your bear-themed custom levels and we’ll feature them in Ultimate Chicken Horse!

[b]Submit your levels to us by publishing your level and sharing the level code in the Steam comments [/b]by [b]11 PM Pacific Time on May 16[/b]. It can be a Party or Challenge level.

To make a custom level, go to the Treehouse lobby. Open the pause menu and click the arrows to change your game mode from "Party Mode" to "Free Play Mode". Then go to the underground area of the Treehouse and move to the left to the "Blank Level" section. Now you can make a level!

Need some inspiration? (These are only suggestions!)
- Any of the new Bear characters (Panda, Brown Bear, Polar Bear, Black Bear, Blue Bear)
- Honey and honeycombs, bees, fish, berries, bamboo, pastries
- Picnics in the park, forests, camp sites, mountain caves, cozy dens
- Colors: Monochrome (black and white), brown, blue
- Anything else you can come up with!

We're super proud to have such a dedicated community 8 years into development! Thank you for playing Ultimate Chicken Horse and sharing our silly animals with your friends. Have a bear-illiant time with this new update! 

Join us on [url=https://discord.gg/UCH]Discord [/url]to find people to play with, and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/ClevEndeavGames]X[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/clevendeavgames/]Instagram[/url] to stay up to date!

notes.title: Server improvements, voting system changes, updated OST, and QoL changes!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’re back after a few months of work on Ultimate Chicken Horse with version 1.10.06 on all platforms. 

We addressed several server issues that came up during the Shellebration Update, changed how voting works on community-made custom levels, and added a new song to the OST. Plus some other minor changes.

Read below for more, and join the [url=https://discord.gg/UCH]Ultimate Chicken Horse Discord[/url] to keep up-to-date with all things Chicken and Horse!

[h2]Server refactor[/h2]
After the Shellebration Update, we had more players online than [b]ever before[/b]. (Wow, thank you!) However, our servers were not prepared for the sheer number of people enjoying the game. This resulted in players experiencing many server desync issues like endless loading screens, getting stuck in the party box, placed blocks not showing up, and lobbies randomly shutting down. 

We’ve just completed a server refactor to address these desync issues and prevent them from happening in the future. It also gives us the ability to add more servers to high traffic regions whenever we have a big influx of new players. :) 

We also addressed a country-wide connection issue for players in Korea. As of today, everyone in Korea should be able to connect and play online again! Thank you for your patience and bug reports - there were many Korean players who helped us solve the problem by sending us their player logs. ❤️

If you experience any server issues or bugs, please report them to the developers in the [url=https://discord.gg/UCH]Ultimate Chicken Horse Discord[/url]. 

[h2]Downvotes removed from custom levels[/h2]
We removed downvotes from the voting system for custom/community-made levels! 

Downvotes were not being used in a way that was useful or kind to our community, which warranted their removal. If you don’t enjoy a level, you now have the choice to upvote it or ignore it. (Note that you can still report levels that break our community rules!)

[h2]Ultimate Chicken Horse OST[/h2]
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/493070/Ultimate_Chicken_Horse_Soundtrack/]game’s soundtrack[/url] just got a new song! It now has the “Shellebration” track which plays during the Metro level.

[h2]Quality of life changes[/h2]
We received feedback that the game's initial volume was too loud, so we reduced it by 20%. (Now the Horse noise is less of a jumpscare!) 

That’s all for now! We’ll be monitoring the server situation and keeping an eye out for any new issues. Have fun out there. 🙂

- Sincerely, Clever Endeavour

notes.title: Announcing the Hippo-Party-Plus Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=2pTnfNFk2CY;full][/previewyoutube]

A new character joins the animal party! Meet Hippo in this FREE content update for [i]Ultimate Chicken Horse[/i], coming to you on [b]September 20, 2021[/b] on all supported platforms!

The [b]Hippo-Party-Plus update[/b] includes:

[list]
[*] 1 new character: Hippopotamus
[*] 1 new alternative skin: Triceratops
[*] 4 new outfits: Floatie (Hippo), Cowboy Boots (Hippo), Balloon (Hippo) Jockey Outfit (Horse)
[*] 1 new level: Rollercoaster
[*] Tons of bug fixes
[/list]
As with previous updates, you’ll be able to unlock the new character, reskin, outfits and level by collecting unlock boxes on all levels with a ? sign. No purchase necessary.

[h2]New Character: Hippopotamus[/h2]

Large and in-charge, Hippopotamus (Hippo for short) joins the Ultimate Chicken Horse cast!

This groovy critter is ready to boogie the house down! Don’t let the goofy smile fool you, Hippo is a real contender for the Ultimate title.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/e91863724694faf59e6a329075ac94e3175ca92d.gif[/img]

[h2]Alternative Skin: Triceratops[/h2]

Head all the way back to the Cretaceous period with Hippo’s alternative skin, Triceratops!

This alternative Hippo skin is compatible with all of the regular Hippo accessories. How did Triceratops safely join the rest of the animals? No one really knows, but we heard it had something to do with a very special car...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/7dcd945e05a568979ee9ec83e39025d428d7d752.png[/img]

[h2]New Outfits[/h2]

Once you’ve become acquainted with Hippo, you’ll be able to unlock these nifty accessories for Hippo and Triceratops:

Cowboy boots: While Hippo usually has dancing shoes on, sometimes they get swapped out for these trusty boots.
Balloon: Picked up from the fairground, its name is Wilson.
Floatie: Hippo can’t swim, so they need this device when they go to the pool with the other animals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/ac2ed68961a1f6828b3a2d89be5d7db3165d91f5.png[/img]

Despite being in the game title, Horse has always been one accessory short, compared to the other critters. But fear not, we bought Horse a new outfit! 

Horse loved it so much we made sure to provide 7 different colour variations: blue, orange, green, purple, red, pink and yellow. While Horse is convinced the outfit is streamlined for speed, it doesn’t do much other than look cool. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/e56f15d1388bfb56ac0ed766f4343b227705ef11.png[/img]

[h2]New Level: Rollercoaster[/h2]
The whole cast and crew have ventured off to the local theme park and a certain attraction has caught their eye: this speeding roller coaster!

Once unlocked, this map will have players placing blocks and traps that allow them to safely pass under the tracks and on to the finish line on another piece of totally safety-compliant scaffolding.
 
Make sure to keep your appendages away from the ride at all times; it will send you right to the grave if you get too close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10073974/d8cfd570e52801ab6c9d560650219a1aa0f4eb06.png[/img]

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

For a full list of changes and bug fixes, click here: https://www.cleverendeavourgames.com/hippo-update

[h2]A Note About Future Updates[/h2]

First off, thank you to everyone who has played Ultimate Chicken Horse over the past 5+ years. This game is what it is today thanks to your love and support, and we’re so incredibly grateful that we’ve been able to support it for so many years!

This update took so much longer to come out versus our initial prediction, and we want to share some context as to why. Last year we discovered that the online architecture we use was going to be retired in the next few years so we started looking for alternatives. We have every intention of keeping Ultimate Chicken Horse functional for as long as we can. Unfortunately, what seemed like a simple thing to change ended up being… not so simple at all. The solutions we found weren’t compatible with the Unity version we have used since the game’s conception and upgrading it to the 2020 version caused a bunch of plugins to break, new issues cropped up on various platforms and so much more. This work already would have taken much longer than expected and it was just made significantly worse with COVID. The original work we had set out to do was taking so much longer than planned, that we made the decision to release new content now rather than wait for the more technical backend architecture to be completed.

This update was also undertaken in tandem with our new project at Clever Endeavour Games - something we’re extremely excited to be working on! If we were a larger studio, we could probably continue to update Ultimate Chicken Horse while working on a new IP. The reality is that we’re only 6 people and this update has already significantly impacted the development of our new title. (If you want to stay up to date with our latest title, sign up for our [url=https://www.cleverendeavourgames.com/]newsletter[/url].)

While we are not saying there won’t ever be new content for Ultimate Chicken Horse, this is the last content update that we have planned for the foreseeable future. We know this will be sad or disappointing for some - there are so many great ideas for new characters, levels, modes and so much more. For us, too, it feels a bit scary as we move into new territory.

To be clear, this does not mean we’re completely shutting down the game. We just spent so much time and energy on making sure this game lasts for as long as it can!! We’re still going to finish the online architecture update, continue featuring levels on LevelNET, host events on Discord, and answer support tickets. As long as there’s a community to support it and we’re able to, we want to keep this party going. So keep sending us your Ultimate Chicken Horse fan art, ideas, and concepts - it keeps us inspired for the future!

Thank you all, once again, and we hope you’ll stick around for our next adventure together.

<3
The Clever Endeavour Team

notes.title: Online Beta Update - Easier To Connect With Friends!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since our last announcement, where we mentioned that the online beta would be coming soon. Well, we've got good news for you! It's actually been out for a little while, but previously people had been having issues connecting and had been experiencing game-breaking bugs. This announcement brings some important changes :)

[img]https://static1.squarespace.com/static/5601be1fe4b0dfb50e050a73/t/5702b7d437013bada73c4eb7/1459795925285/016_Multiplayer2.PNG[/img]

[h1]Online Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*]No more need for port forwarding
[*]Scoring system works properly and games end at the right time
[*]For a full list of fixes, check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/386940/discussions/0/405692224229453172/]Steam discussion here[/url]
[/list]

There are definitely still bugs though, which is why it's still in Beta. If you're experiencing bugs that aren't on the known list, please [url=http://ultimatechickenhorse.com/bugreport]submit them here[/url].

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list]
[*]No sudden death when there's a tie game
[*]Two coins can't be picked up at the same time online
[*]For the full list of known issues, check out the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/386940/discussions/0/405694115204379944/]Steam discussion here[/url].
[/list]

[h1]Next Steps?[/h1]

We're working on making sure that the online play is seamless and there are no game-breaking bugs, so that's the highest priority. We've also started looking into setting up server lists so that you can join a game online without needing to have friends! I mean... without needing to invite friends to play online. This will act as a sort of "matchmaking", and we may look into doing real matchmaking at some point, but that will come later. 

For now, enjoy the game, and if you want updates, be sure to [url=http://twitter.com/ClevEndeavGames]follow us on Twitter[/url]. Thank you!
